text:
Nina H.: heads-up: onboarding nebula-128k (int4) to staging. started a longprefill + sliding-window run and saw repeating token groups after the window slides past 131071 tokens.
Raj S.: repeating groups as in duplication of previous context or a new garbage token?
Nina H.: duplication. example: the model echoes a short 6-token sequence repeatedly every ~512 tokens after crossing the boundary.
Nina H.: short snip: 
```
... prior: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog and continued with new items."
post-boundary: "The quick brown fox jumps over the quick brown fox jumps over the quick brown fox..."
```
Marta Q.: hmm. 131072 is 2^17, looks like a ring buffer wrap. Could be RoPE phase handling when positions > max_pos or a KV index aliasing bug.
QA-bot: added test tag q/nebula-128k/window-slip-01 and scheduled perf smoke.
Raj S.: does this happen only on int4 path or also fp16?
Nina H.: only on int4 GPU runs so far. CPU fp16 baseline clean. Also reproduces with quantized emulation (int4 packer) in local unit tests.
Marta Q.: that suggests pack/unpack or the position-encoding read for high positions. If RoPE frequency scaling used by nebula assumes a 16-bit position index internally we could overflow.
Raj S.: can you dump the KV index values around the boundary? specifically: key idx, shard id, pos mod, and base offset.
Nina H.: pasted small table from debug dump: 
```
idx,shard,pos_mod,offset
131066,0,131066,0x7f3a1ad0
131067,0,131067,0x7f3a1b10
131068,1,12,0x7f3a1c50  # shard rollover, pos_mod wrapped to 12
131069,1,13,0x7f3a1c90
```
Marta Q.: oof pos_mod wrapped to 12 while idx continues. that points at an incorrect modular reduction when computing RoPE phase table lookup during shard transition.
Raj S.: runtime code reduces position by (pos & pos_mask) for table lookup; looks like pos_mask is 0x0fff somewhere in int4 path due to a truncated compute. suspect a narrowing cast in the kernel.
Nina H.: adding a quick patch in the kernel to use 64-bit for position arithmetic avoided the repeat in a smoke rerun. full regression queued.
QA-bot: regression run q/nebula-128k/window-slip-01 shows 0/40 failures after patch on staging.
infra-bot: collected GPU kernel logs for run id 202672 and driver versions: nvidia-driver 535.104, cuda 12.2, h100-rt 1.9. Collected ccaches and memmaps.
Marta Q.: next steps: 1) add assert in RoPE lookup that position monotonicity holds across shard boundaries, 2) add unit that fuzzes large positions for packing/overflow, 3) add a CI canary that runs position > 100k on int4.
Raj S.: also audit the packer casts - any implicit int -> int16/uint16 operations in codegen paths. I've seen implicit narrowing slip through in older kernels.
Nina H.: opening PR with kernel change + unit tests referencing the regression run. will include the smoke outputs and mini reproducer for local devs.
Marta Q.: thanks. after merge let's run dedicated canary on A100 and V100 as well just to be safe.
Nina H.: queued canaries. will ping once green. :party:
